Yes, a petitioner may withdraw a technically complete petition that is deemed inadequate because the data are unclear, without hurting a future filing. This withdrawal will be without prejudice to a future filing, and upon refiling, the time limitation will begin to run anew from the date of refiling [4].

21 CFR 71.6(c)(1) permits a petitioner to withdraw a petition that is technically complete but inadequate due to unclear or insufficient data, and such withdrawal will be without prejudice to a future filing [4].  
21 CFR 71.6(c)(2) allows a petitioner to withdraw the petition at any time before the order for publication in the Federal Register, with the same effect of being without prejudice to a future filing [5].
